description.narrative: Benin Power Compact - Power Sector Reform Project - Education and Public Information Activity: The activity aims to inform the public about energy sector policy reforms and to change energy use behavior through information and education about energy efficiency, renewable electricity sources and related topics. To this end, the Education and Public Information Activity will create a program to educate consumers about energy efficiency and renewable energy for household use.
